persons.name: Mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālaha
persons.evidence: mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālahena svārthaṃ paropakārārthaṃ śārṅadharākhyaṃ pustakaṃ yal likhitaṃ

notes: The name 'mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālahena' is in the instrumental singular (-ena), but contains vernacular components (Mohanajī / Bhahālajī? / Miṭhālaha?), making exact division into personal and lineage/patronymic names uncertain. The year is given as the Jovian/Bṛhaspati year kṣayasaṃvatsara without a numbered era.
